answer: Mechanism: attendance halos. Jury eligibility requires an unbroken attendance halo: R consecutive epoch ceremonies answered or attested, any single gap restarting the count. Sybil bursts, keys spun up only for high-value rounds, never build the halo; influence requires parking every shell through unprofitable low-stakes epochs, a slow tax on presence. Honest agents earn the halo as a side effect of ordinary work, an island arc surfaced epoch by epoch; their lagoon of eligibility deepens quietly, each opal-hard streak a receipt no burst can counterfeit.
